model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", uses a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ (1) to $2^8$ (256), with tick marks at each power of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.9. The plot shows that coverage increases for all models as the number of completions increases. The Llama-3B model (blue line with circles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.43 and reaches a maximum of about 0.9. The Llama-3B + FT model (green line with triangles) begins at a slightly higher coverage of around 0.45 and also reaches a maximum of approximately 0.9. The Llama-1B model (light blue line with squares) starts at a coverage of about 0.3 and increases to a maximum of roughly 0.85. The Llama-1B + FT model (light green line with inverted triangles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.32 and reaches a maximum of about 0.87.
